changelog: Security: .env file protected — all file API endpoints block .env, .ssh, .gnupg, credentials, key files
Security: Tauri CSP set — no more null Content-Security-Policy in webview
Security: assetProtocol.scope narrowed from ** to app-specific directories
Security: npm vulnerabilities patched (fast-uri, nanoid)
Fixed: frontend dist rebuilt with all uncommitted features (NewSessionModal, cliLogos, screenshot, agent-workspace)
Fixed: .env file restored after accidental overwrite during audit
Updated: version bumped to 2.3.1 across all manifests
Added: IDE View (VS Code layout — activity bar, file explorer, tabbed editor, breadcrumbs, welcome page with TTO logo, Send-to-Terminal panel, status bar)
Added: Floating colorful wire connections in Task Center (8-color palette, animated flowing particles, click-to-connect endpoints, persistent per workspace)
Added: UI Inspector (Cmd+Shift+A) for annotating UI elements
Added: Command Palette (Cmd+P) for quick file search and actions
Added: File Drag & Drop onto terminal panes (shell-escaped, injected into PTY)
Improved: Attractive sidebar redesign (gradient background, glowing live dots, hover animations, accent borders)
Improved: IDE welcome page with floating TTO logo and styled keyboard shortcuts
Improved: File send to terminal now works in Tauri mode (uses PTY directly)
Improved: CEO agent dispatch resolves Tauri sessions correctly
Improved: Wire overlay z-index raised for better visibility
Fixed: Workspace selector no longer incorrectly sends file paths
Fixed: CLI auto-close race when creating multiple terminals
Fixed: Terminal pane goes blank after switching workspace tabs
Updated: Instruction guide with all current features (v2.3.0)
